subject: Post-demo technical recap + dev pilot checklist
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Rhodes <samantha@novushealth.ai>, Daniel Park <daniel.park@novushealth.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 10 Jul 2028 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo technical recap + dev pilot checklist

Hi Samantha / Daniel —

Thanks again for your time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can get the Novus dev pilot running this week:

Objective (2-week technical pilot): validate SDK integration paths (Python + TypeScript), confirm auth/routing model, exercise embeddings + reranker workflow on a subset of sample patient data, and run the local sample app end-to-end.

Attached: novus-integration-checklist.xlsx (pilot tasks + success criteria), redwood-sdk-sampleapps.zip (tiny Python/TS samples), arch-diagram-v1.png. Repo (live samples): https://github.com/redwood-inference/sample-apps/tree/novus-pilot

High-level steps (owners and expected time):
- Environment & creds (Novus infra): Novus to provide test VM + VPN access or sandbox network (owner: Daniel) — 1 business day.
- SDK quickstart (Dev): Install and run local sample apps (owner: Novus devs, assisted by Redwood) — 0.5 day.
  - Python: pip install redwood-sdk
  - TypeScript: npm install @redwood-inference/sdk
- Auth & routing (Security): choose between hosted API key vs ephemeral tokens + VPC/private deployment. We'll provide short OIDC guide if you need SSO-bound creds (owner: Marcus) — 1 day.
- Embeddings & rerankers (ML): sample notebook in repo; we recommend indexing a 5k-row subset and testing a rerank pass to validate latency/quality (owner: Lauren) — 2 days.
- Local end-to-end test: sample frontend -> calls to SDK -> structured output / tool-calling stub for linking to EMR (owner: Novus devs + Redwood) — 1 day.

Quick notes on staging config we recommend for the pilot:
- Use the sandbox endpoint: https://sandbox.api.redwood.ai (set REDWOOD_API_URL env var)
- Use a scoped API key with embeddings and generation scopes only (we will issue).
- For routing during pilot, pin region to us-west and model variant to text-gen-std-1 (--model=text-gen-std-1) to stabilize latency.

Immediate asks from Novus so we can start:
1) Confirm pilot VM or confirm you want Redwood-hosted sandbox.
2) Provide one dev contact for installing sample apps and one security contact for credentialing.
3) Confirm whether you need Private (VPC) pilot or Hosted sandbox for initial dev tests.

Can we lock a 30-min technical kickoff tomorrow or Wednesday? My scheduling link is below — we'll do a short runthrough of the checklist and hand off repo access.

Calendly: https://calendly.com/vanessa-redwood/tech-kickoff-30m

Thanks — looking forward to getting this live.

—
Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise Solutions
Redwood Inference
vanessa@redwood.ai

Hi Vanessa —

This looks great and thanks for the clear checklist. A couple clarifying questions from our side before we kick off: 
1) Data residency — our team prefers US-only storage for patient data. Are embeddings stored in the same region as the endpoint, and can we limit to a US region for the pilot?
2) Private deployment — we may need the VPC option for the pilot; what is the minimal operational overhead to do a quick VPC sandbox?

Owners: I'll loop in our infra lead (Daniel) to confirm VM/VPC decisions. We'd prefer to start with Hosted sandbox if the residency can be locked to US. If that works, can we target a kickoff Wednesday 11:00am PT?

From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Rhodes <samantha@novushealth.ai>, Daniel Park <daniel.park@novushealth.ai>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 11 Jul 2028 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo technical recap + dev pilot checklist

Hi Samantha / Daniel —

Quick answers to the technical questions you raised: 

1) Data residency and embeddings: For Hosted sandbox we can pin the region to us-west-2 for the pilot. Embeddings created during the pilot will be stored in the same region and isolated to your account namespace. If you need a contractual guarantee, we can elevate to a Private/VPC pilot (shorter SLA required) — that adds a provisioning step but we can still do a limited-duration VPC sandbox.

2) Minimal VPC sandbox overhead: expect a 2–3 business day lead for private provisioning + firewall rules if you want full VPC. For a faster start, host credentials to our sandbox (hosted) and restrict by IP allowlist from your VPN.

3) CSV schema suggestion for embeddings: id, text, metadata_json (stringified JSON). Example header: id,text,metadata
- metadata JSON can include patient_age_group, note_type, created_at. Avoid PHI; de-identify before upload.

4) SDK quickstart notes (local dev):
- Python:
  - python -m venv venv
  - source venv/bin/activate
  - pip install redwood-sdk
  - export REDWOOD_API_KEY="sk_test_xxx"
  - export REDWOOD_API_URL="https://sandbox.api.redwood.ai"
  - python samples/python/end_to_end.py

- TypeScript:
  - npm install @redwood-inference/sdk
  - export REDWOOD_API_KEY=sk_test_xxx
  - export REDWOOD_API_URL=https://sandbox.api.redwood.ai
  - node samples/ts/run-example.js

5) Auth & tokens: we recommend scoped API keys for the pilot. If you want short-lived tokens bound to internal SSO, we can send an OIDC guide and an example exchange flow (will require minor infra changes on your side). For now, scoped static keys + IP allowlist is the fastest path.

6) Embedding / rerank model suggestions:
- Embeddings: text-embed-large-002 (good balance of latency vs quality)
- Reranker: rerank-mono-v1 used as a second-stage pass. Expect ~50–80ms 99p on pinned us-west infra for our sample size.

7) Example simple curl to verify env is working:
  curl -X POST "$REDWOOD_API_URL/v1/generate" -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"model":"text-gen-std-1","input":"hello"}'

If you want, I can drop a small notebook that walks through index -> embed -> rerank for your CSV.

Thanks — happy to join the kickoff.

—Marcus
Senior Solution Engineer
marcus@redwood.ai
